name: All Mothers Lie
overview: All Mothers Lie is an Israeli comedy-drama series created by Yael Katz, Noam Nevo and Natalie Michaelashvili-Dror, directed by Atara Frish. The series is a sports drama produced by Green Productions and United King Films. The plot centers on a single mother who decides to embark on a sporting journey and play basketball, in an attempt to positively influence her son's life and get him out of his sedentary lifestyle.
